question: Which exact-symbol, chromosome-compatible protein-coding entries from the preserved DuPage exploratory screen warrant biological follow-up?
decision: Separate a protein-target reading frontier from noncoding labels that dominate the poly-A RNA-seq ranking; retain the full v1 findings.
strongest_rival: Biotype, stale symbol or overlapping-transcript measurement errors can create large robust RNA estimates without measuring the proposed target product; activation mixture and survival selection remain unresolved.
discriminator: Add pinned NCBI mouse gene type and exact symbol/chromosome identity without refitting any expression estimate; retain all excluded/unmatched rows. This does not verify protein abundance or direct regulation.
exposure_record: All v1 ranks, 26 displayed genes and 19 anchors were inspected. The poly-A protocol prompted a separate protein-coding view. No v2 coding ranks calculated before this freeze.
biological_unit: Source biological preparation; individual mouse, pool membership and cross-state pairing remain unknown. This stage counts files/features, not animals.
nesting_and_overlap: Twelve libraries from one study; GSM1423627 excluded by authors. All reuse of these libraries is shared-source reanalysis. Replicate labels do not prove pairing or independence.
population_and_selection: Female C57BL/6 healthy mosaic mice; spleen/LN sorted Foxp3-positive CD4+CD25+YFP+RFP+ Tregs, conditional Ezh2 HET or KO, observed CD62L high/low.
contrast: (mean log2(FPKM+1) KO_low - HET_low) - (KO_high - HET_high); observed states, not a temporal intervention.
endpoint: Exact annotation audit and protein-coding restriction of the unchanged v1 signed orderings.
methods: TARGET_SCREEN_AMENDMENT_V2.md: taxon 10090, exact case-sensitive symbol, unique GeneID, matching chromosome, type protein-coding. No aliases or cross-build coordinate conversion. Reuse v1 numeric estimates and sort rules; first 10 per signed track is a reading budget. Keep full annotations, old frontier audit, new frontier and anchors.
missingness_and_exclusions: Keep every v1 locus in annotation audit. Exclude unmatched, ambiguous, chromosome-discordant and non-protein-coding entries only from the separate coding ranking; do not erase original outcomes.
multiplicity: No tests, FDR or probability of target validity. All loci retained; top 10 per signed track is a finite reading budget, not an effect threshold.
precision_basis: Observed sample variation and PCA only; no confidence intervals because mouse/pool identity and independence are not qualified.
interpretation_limit: Post-outcome exploratory RNA selection from surviving Foxp3-positive preparations. Sensitivity stability cannot establish biological independence, direct Ezh2 regulation, protein expression, cell function, novelty or target validity.
stop_rule: Stop on mismatched hashes, duplicate v1 symbols or missing annotation fields. Do not retune ranking after viewing v2. Uninformative output is a valid outcome.
amendment_reason: Assay qualification after the v1 frontier was dominated by noncoding labels despite source poly-A library selection. Prospective protein-target restriction; v1 remains intact.
